018 loads preserved rows without verifying preserved slot, source publisher, coverage contract, safety flags or the pinned preserved evidence blob.
Preserved min, max, height difference and confidence are converted to float without finite checks; NaN can bypass drift comparison and json.dump can emit non-standard NaN.
018 binds row number and HMLR ID but copies the current parcel_id without comparing it to preserved parcel identity.
013 requires three joined rows but not the exact target set, distinct HMLR IDs or exactly three EA samples; duplicate EA rows are silently collapsed by a dict.
016 accepts exit code zero then reads a pre-existing output path without a run token, creation time or current-stage hash binding.
016 invokes resolver and crosschecker with subprocess.run and no timeout.
016 reads archive paths from the resolver manifest but never compares current archive bytes to resolver-recorded size and SHA before extraction.
Configured-root discovery accepts matching files without proving resolved containment or rejecting symlinks.
026 returns exit code zero when one daemon exists without checking fresh heartbeat, exact continuation claim, task identity or progress.
030 trusts helper exit code and does not validate the fresh 014 receipt status, timestamp, counts and task identity.
030 fetches configured origin without verifying its URL resolves to the expected repository.
026 identifies processes by broad command-line substrings, allowing unrelated processes to block restart or satisfy daemon presence.
